q1_issues.issue: The molting sky-cat is given Agent, but molt is a non-volitional internal change of state that the subject undergoes, which the intransitive-subject test routes to Patient (Agent is reserved for motion / volitional / self-propelled subjects).

q2_gaps: a non-deictic season time expression with a phase modifier ("in early autumn"): the Time section defines structured terms only for Year/Month/Day/Weekday/Hour/Minute, bare symbols for day-parts and for deictic seasons (last_spring / next_summer), and says nothing about a plain or phase-modified season, so the fused bare symbol early_autumn (and whether it should decompose) is unspecified
notes: Otherwise the bare-plural verbal generic is correctly a distributing rule with a Skolem-function event at 0.9/0.9, and sky_cat emits the head genus only (noun modifier not exposed).
